correctness.rationale: For squarefree n=pqrs with p<q<r<s, sigma(n)=2phi(n) becomes H(p)H(q)H(r)H(s)=2, H(t)=(t+1)/(t-1) strictly decreasing. Even n and p=3 are excluded; p>=13 gives product <(7/6)^4<2. Ordered q/r monotone bounds leave exactly p,q in (5,11),(5,13),(5,17),(7,11) and 15 eligible triples. For any triple A=H(p)H(q)H(r), fourth prime is uniquely s=(2+A)/(2-A) if A<2. Independent rational branch enumeration reproduced exactly eight prime quadruples: (5,11,23,109), (5,13,17,127), (5,13,19,71), (5,13,23,43), (5,13,29,31), (5,17,19,31), (7,11,13,29), (7,11,17,19). The packaged exact verifier was read, but infinite exhaustiveness is from the displayed inequalities, not a blind size cutoff.
